qoder-setup.title: Prepare Qoder ACP configuration
qoder-setup.intro: Choose the reviewed model and local Qoder executable, then prepare a new configuration file on the target machine.
qoder-setup.model_help: Enter the exact model approved for this Qoder installation. No model is selected automatically.
qoder-setup.credential_help: Enter only a separate environment variable name, never its value. Leave blank to use the existing Qoder CLI login.
qoder-setup.executable_help: Use its absolute native executable path, not a script or launcher wrapper.
qoder-setup.version_help: Enter the exact version reviewed by your administrator. This declaration is not an observed version check.
qoder-setup.output_help: Use an absolute local path. The folder must exist; the file must not already exist.
qoder-setup.incomplete: Complete the six fields with valid values to prepare the command. The credential name may be blank.
qoder-setup.blocked: Finish the current operation before preparing another configuration.
qoder-setup.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the command shown above.
qoder-setup.copy_boundary: Command copied. No file has been created and Qoder has not been run.
qoder-setup.boundary: Run the command yourself on the target machine. It checks the native file and writes a new configuration without starting Qoder, signing in or calling a model. Copying or using a path does not prove the file exists; reporting, registration and enabling are separate steps.
qoder-setup.manual_help: Advanced: this example preserves the fixed ACP startup arguments. Save and validate it on the target machine; it is not an installation or execution result.
